TechSur Solutions is a digital services company focused on digital transformation, cloud services, modernization, Agile development, and data analytics. The Junior Infrastructure Engineer will support cloud and on-premises infrastructure operations, systems administration, automation, monitoring, troubleshooting, security, and DevOps activities for a USCIS federal program.
Big Data
Artificial Intelligence (AI)
Consulting
Information Technology
Analytics
H1B Sponsor Likely
Responsibilities
Assist in the implementation, configuration, administration, and maintenance of cloud and on-premises infrastructure
Support Linux and/or Windows servers, virtual machines, storage, network components, and related infrastructure services
Assist senior engineers with provisioning, configuration, upgrades, patching, and ongoing maintenance of infrastructure environments
Monitor infrastructure availability, system performance, capacity, and health using enterprise monitoring and logging tools
Troubleshoot common server, operating system, network, application connectivity, and infrastructure-related issues
Support cloud infrastructure services in AWS and/or Azure environments
Assist with infrastructure automation and Infrastructure as Code (IaC) using tools such as Terraform, CloudFormation, Ansible, or similar technologies
Support CI/CD pipelines and DevSecOps processes in collaboration with application development and engineering teams
Assist with containerized environments using Docker and Kubernetes/OpenShift, where applicable
Support identity and access management activities, including user access, permissions, service accounts, and role-based access controls
Assist with vulnerability remediation, system hardening, security patches, and configuration updates in accordance with established federal and organizational security requirements
Participate in incident troubleshooting, root-cause analysis, and resolution of infrastructure-related issues
Create and maintain technical documentation, including configuration documents, SOPs, runbooks, architecture information, troubleshooting guides, and knowledge-base articles
Support infrastructure changes across development, testing, staging, and production environments
Work with senior engineers to improve infrastructure reliability, availability, scalability, security, and operational efficiency
Participate in Agile ceremonies, technical meetings, sprint activities, and team discussions as needed
Assist with production deployments and operational support activities when required
Escalate complex infrastructure and security issues to senior engineers and appropriate technical teams
Qualification
AWS
Microsoft Azure
Linux and Windows Server Administration
Python, PowerShell, and Bash Scripting
Git and Version Control
Infrastructure as Code with Terraform, CloudFormation, or Ansible
Identity and Access Management and Role-Based Access Control
Cybersecurity, System Hardening, and Vulnerability Management
Docker, Kubernetes, and OpenShift
Required
1-3 years of relevant experience in Infrastructure Engineering, Systems Administration, Cloud Engineering, DevOps, IT Operations, or a related technical field
Foundational knowledge of AWS and/or Microsoft Azure cloud services
Basic administration knowledge of Linux and/or Windows Server environments
Understanding of networking concepts, including:
TCP/IP
DNS
DHCP
HTTP/HTTPS
VPN
Firewalls
Load balancers
Subnets and routing
Basic understanding of cloud networking and security concepts
Familiarity with scripting using Python, PowerShell, Bash, or Shell scripting
Basic knowledge of Git/version control
Familiarity with CI/CD concepts and tools such as Jenkins, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Azure DevOps, or similar
Basic knowledge of Infrastructure as Code tools such as Terraform, CloudFormation, or Ansible
Understanding monitoring, logging, alerting, and troubleshooting concepts
Basic understanding of Identity and Access Management (IAM) and role-based access control
Understanding of general cybersecurity principles, secure configurations, patching, and vulnerability management
Strong troubleshooting and analytical skills
Ability to work effectively with developers, infrastructure engineers, security teams, and other technical stakeholders
Good written and verbal communication skills
Ability to create and maintain clear technical documentation
Bachelor's degree in computer science, Information Technology, Information Systems, Engineering, Cybersecurity, or a related technical discipline
Preferred
Hands-on experience with AWS services such as EC2, S3, VPC, IAM, CloudWatch, RDS, Route 53, or related services
Experience with Microsoft Azure infrastructure services
Exposure to Docker, Kubernetes, or OpenShift
Experience with Terraform, Ansible, AWS CloudFormation, or other infrastructure automation technologies
Familiarity with observability and monitoring tools such as Splunk, CloudWatch, Datadog, Grafana, Prometheus, or similar
Understanding of DevOps/DevSecOps methodologies
Experience working in Agile/Scrum environments
Understanding of SSL/TLS certificates, encryption, secrets management, and secure credential handling
Exposure to federal cybersecurity and compliance environments, including NIST, FISMA, FedRAMP, or DHS security standards
Previous experience supporting a federal government client, particularly DHS or USCIS, is a plus
Benefits
Hybrid workplace arrangement: in-office 3x/week
